name: Barèges
description: Barèges is one of France's oldest thermal spa towns — the Thermes de Barèges have operated continuously since the 17th century, using natural sulphur-rich spring waters (32-48°C) for rheumatological, orthopaedic, and respiratory treatments. Three-week cures are reimbursable by French health insurance. Shorter 3-6 day wellness stays available without prescription. As the western gateway to Grand Tourmalet, the ski area is accessed from the Tournaboup sector 3km above the village (free shuttle). The Lienz forest runs offer sheltered skiing in bad weather — a wilder, more intimate atmosphere than La Mongie. Spa village charm with stone houses along the Bastan river. Gateway to Néouvielle Nature Reserve and the Col du Tourmalet cycling route.

overview.atmosphere: One of France's oldest thermal spa towns (since 17th century). Authentic Pyrenean mountain village. Western gateway to Grand Tourmalet — largest ski domain in the French Pyrenees (100km). Lienz forest runs provide sheltered skiing in bad weather. On the Route des Cols (Col du Tourmalet).

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Snowshoeing, sledding, hiking in Pyrenees National Park, mountain biking, fishing. Traditional village atmosphere with stone houses.

honest_drawbacks: Requires shuttle to Tournaboup for ski access (3km)
